title: Shipping Policy
intro: We partner with reliable logistics providers to ensure timely and safe delivery of your KokoFresh orders. By placing an order, you agree to the shipping terms outlined here.

sections.heading: Scope of the Policy
sections.body:
This Shipping Policy applies to all orders placed on the KokoFresh website. Our goal is to ensure a smooth and reliable delivery experience for our customers. By using our platform, you agree to the terms outlined in this policy.

From our kitchen to yours, we ensure every order is handled with care and precision.

sections.heading: Key Shipping Features
sections.lede: How your order travels from our kitchen to your door.

items.title: Serviceable Locations
items.description: Orders are delivered within the locations listed on our service coverage page. Customers must confirm their delivery address falls within a serviceable area.

items.title: Delivery Timelines
items.description: Standard delivery: orders are typically delivered within 2–5 business days, depending on the location.

items.title: Packaging Standards
items.description: All products are packaged to ensure they remain fresh, safe, and intact during transit.

items.title: Order Tracking
items.description: Once your order is shipped, you will receive a confirmation email or SMS with tracking details.

items.title: Variable Pricing
items.description: Shipping fees vary based on the order value and delivery location — ₹50 within Karnataka, ₹70 for the rest of India.

items.title: Free Shipping Available
items.description: Free shipping is automatically applied to all orders of ₹399 and above at checkout.

items.title: Clear at Checkout
items.description: Any applicable shipping charges are displayed clearly at checkout before payment.

sections.heading: Delivery Issues
sections.lede: We’re here to help if anything goes wrong with your delivery.

items.title: Failed Delivery Attempts
items.description: If the delivery is unsuccessful due to an incorrect address or customer unavailability, the logistics provider may attempt redelivery.

items.title: Delayed Delivery
items.description: Customers will be notified of delays. Refunds or credits will not be issued for delays caused by factors beyond our control.

items.title: Lost or Stolen Orders
items.description: If an order is marked as delivered but not received, report the issue within 24 hours. We will investigate and resolve the matter.

items.title: Accurate Details
items.description: Ensure that the delivery address and contact details provided during checkout are accurate.

items.title: Be Available
items.description: Be available to receive the delivery at the specified address within the estimated timeframe.

items.title: Inspect on Arrival
items.description: Inspect the order upon receipt and report any issues (e.g. damaged packaging or incorrect items) immediately to our support team.

items.title: Quick Processing
items.description: We process returns and refunds quickly to get you back on track.

items.title: Multiple Options
items.description: Choose between refunds, replacements, or store credits.

items.title: Hassle-Free Process
items.description: No complicated procedures — just reach out to our support team.

items.title: Liability Disclaimer
items.description: KokoFresh is not liable for delays, losses, or damages caused by third-party logistics providers or events beyond our control. We are not responsible for product spoilage due to improper handling or storage after delivery.

items.title: Restricted Items
items.description: Products that do not comply with food safety regulations or legal standards are strictly prohibited on our platform. Sellers found in violation may face penalties or removal from KokoFresh.

items.title: Changes to Shipping Policy
items.description: KokoFresh reserves the right to modify this Shipping Policy at any time. Updates will be communicated via email or notifications on the platform. Continued use of our services after changes implies acceptance of the revised terms.

items.title: Contact Us
items.description: Our support team is here to help. Reach out anytime at help@kokofresh.in or +91 78927 76610 with questions about shipping.

faq.question: What are the shipping charges for KokoFresh orders?
faq.answer: Shipping is ₹50 for orders within Karnataka and ₹70 for the rest of India. Orders of ₹399 and above ship free.

faq.question: Does KokoFresh offer free shipping?
faq.answer: Yes. Shipping is free on all orders of ₹399 and above at checkout.

faq.question: What are KokoFresh delivery timelines?
faq.answer: Orders are ground fresh and dispatched within 48 hours, then delivered in 3–5 days depending on your location.

closing.heading: Ready to Order?
closing.body: Browse our collection of authentic, handcrafted spices and get them delivered fresh to your door.
